theme: It Was Then That (Advanced Cleft & Fronting)
phoneme_focus: Nuclear stress placement on the emphasised element; fronting intonation

grammar_point.title: Advanced cleft sentences & fronting
grammar_point.en: Rearrange for emphasis and information flow: cleft (It is… that; What/All/The thing… is) and fronting of objects/complements.
grammar_point.ar: إعادة الترتيب للتوكيد وتدفّق المعلومة: الجُمَل المشقوقة وتقديم المفعول/المكمّل.

Sunday.prompt: Use 'What/All/The thing … is …' to foreground key points.

Monday.prompt: Front objects/complements for effect ('That I can't accept.').

Tuesday.prompt: Give an opinion, using clefts to signal what matters most.

Wednesday.prompt: Analyse a situation, foregrounding the crux with cleft structures.

Thursday.prompt: Debate a point with a partner, using clefts to steer emphasis.

Friday.prompt: Present an argument (10-12 sentences) using varied cleft & fronting for emphasis.

writing_prompts: Write three 'It is/was … that …' cleft sentences.
Write three 'What/All/The thing … is …' cleft sentences.
Rewrite three neutral sentences to foreground the key element.
Write an opinion using clefts to signal your main point.
Analyse a topic, using clefts to highlight the crux.
Write an emphatic paragraph using varied cleft and fronting structures.
